text:
lee_platform: FYI prod-usw1 warm-pool struggled to join after yesterday's egress tighten. nodes stuck in JOIN_PENDING -> kubelet retries.
sarah_sre: confirmed, saw ~40 join retries across two clusters and some scheduler backpressure.
ops-bot: change CHG-2026-0510-EG applied at 2026-05-10T08:15Z -> egress-default-deny rollout
dmitri_fw: quick check: firewall generator produced policy but the keystore and kms FQDNs were expanded to IP set and pruned because of a regex bug that drops hostnames with underscore-like tokens
kevin: that explains it. keystore endpoints were in a newer naming format keystore_v3.usw1.internal and got dropped from allowlist
lee_platform: repro: from an affected node: `curl -v https://keystore_v3.usw1.internal:443` -> TLS handshake times out, kubelet logs show "dial tcp ... connection reset"
sarah_sre: NATGW conntrack spiked momentarily due to retries, but main failure is network-level deny. cold-start backpressure ~60 node-minutes.
dmitri_fw: I rolled a temporary allow for `keystore_v3.*` and `kms.usw1.internal` at 08:28Z. warm-pool started recovering +14 nodes in 7m
kevin: filed patch to policy generator to stop hostname pruning and added unit test. will push to staging and validate with policy-validator job
lee_platform: auditshipper also retried a lot; estimated S3 PutObject retry cost ~$310 between 08:15-08:35. billing, please tag charges
billing: created ticket BILL-2026-0510-AUDIT for chargeback. need line items and exact timestamps
sarah_sre: action items: 1) generator fix and staging validation (dmitri) 2) add keystore/KMS allowlist smoke test to rollout pipeline (lee) 3) auditshipper backoff circuit (kevin) 4) update egress rollout runbook to include quick keystore handshake check (sarah)
dmitri_fw: decision: keep temporary allowlist and pause default-deny rollout in prod-usw1 until generator patch validated. CHG-2026-0510 updated
lee_platform: thanks all. I'll kick off postmortem with rough impact: ~60 node-minutes, ~14 recovered warm-pool joins, S3 retry ~$310. Closing once generator patch + auditshipper PR merged :thumbsup:
